function.name: plant_biomass
function.description: Calculate the biomass of a plant species in a given area. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

species_name.description: The name of the plant species.

area.description: The area of the forest in square kilometers. This is a float type value.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time air‑quality data. However, you can check the current Air Quality Index (AQI) for Los Angeles on the U.S. EPA’s AirNow website or use a trusted weather app that provides live AQI updates. If you’d like, I can explain what the AQI numbers mean and how they affect health.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "洛杉磯現在的空氣質量如何？" which means "What is the current air quality in Los Angeles?" They want real-time data. We cannot provide real-time data. According to policy, we should refuse or safe complete. We can offer to provide general info about typical air quality and how to check. So we should refuse to provide real-time data.
